gap: Prices for charter flights not stated
blurb: Priester Aviation offers private jet charter services with a private fleet of advanced aircraft including small, midsize, and heavy business jets. They provide full-service 91 or 135 flight department management and customizable flight department solutions. Their 1945 Jet Card offers point-to-point pricing with concierge-level service and immediate booking with guaranteed availability.
